name: claudish-tts
description: Francis Behnen's fork of claudish-to-english, diverging to add text-to-speech.

plugins.name: claudish-to-english
plugins.description: Shows a plain-English rewrite of each Claude Code assistant message, produced by your Claude Code subscription via the local claude CLI (the default, which sends message text to Anthropic), a local LLM via ollama, the Anthropic API, or any OpenAI-compatible API. ollama is the only provider under which nothing leaves your machine. Display-only.
